projects.title: PastryStock
projects.description: Complete inventory management system for bakeries with ARIMA stock forecasting, built with Flutter and Python backend. Features real-time inventory tracking and predictive analytics.

projects.title: Gesture Clone Robot
projects.description: Robotic arm system that autonomously mimics human hand gestures using OpenCV and computer vision. Implements real-time gesture recognition and servo motor control.

projects.title: Schedule Assistant App
projects.description: Intelligent scheduling application that helps users manage tasks and appointments. Features smart notifications and AI-powered schedule suggestions built with Flutter.

projects.title: Tofico Analyzer
projects.description: Multi-criteria decision-making tool using SAW (Simple Additive Weighting) and WP (Weighted Product) methods. Analyzes and evaluates complex decision scenarios with data visualization.

projects.title: Filling Machine w/ ESP32
projects.description: Automated filling machine system with ESP32 microcontroller. Features web-based control interface, real-time monitoring, and data logging via MQTT protocol.

projects.title: Control Motor via Dabble
projects.description: Motor control system that can be operated via Dabble mobile app over Bluetooth. Features multiple control modes and real-time feedback from the motor sensors.

projects.title: Sistem Pakan Ayam Otomatis
projects.description: Automated chicken feeding system with ESP32 control and web monitoring dashboard. Features remote scheduling and real-time monitoring via web interface.
